title: Traumatic brain injury and concussion in the hospital
question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the head injury (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/13/2026
Reason for Admission: Fall with concussion

Hospital Course:
83 y/o female pt admitted for overnight observation following a fall. Pt c/o head strike and was unconscious for approximately 5 minutes. Neuro exam stable. CT and MRI of the brain were both normal. Pt remained stable throughout stay. No acute distress. Vital signs WNL. Pt cleared for discharge to home.

Discharge Diagnoses:
Concussion

Discharge Medications:
Acetaminophen 500mg BID PRN for pain.

Follow-up:
F/u with PCP in 1 week for routine evaluation.

Electronically signed
P. O'Brien, MD
05/13/2026
explanations: Concussion with loss of consciousness of 30 minutes or less, initial encounter: S06.0X1A (no HCC).

distractors.why: A concussion is documented with normal imaging, not a diffuse injury.
